academic_requirements: A high school diploma is required.
For applicants with a foreign qualification, the diploma must normally follow at least 12 years of documented schooling.
If the awarding country requires a university-entry or academic-suitability examination, evidence of passing it is required.
qualification_system_requirements: High school diploma issued after at least 12 years of documented studies.
Qualifications awarded after fewer than 12 years are assessed under the applicable ministerial provisions for international students.
The qualification must grant access to higher education in the system where it was awarded.
language_requirements: The programme is taught in English.
Applicants must provide evidence of English proficiency accepted by the programme; the current programme listing names Cambridge English, IELTS, TOEFL, or an equivalent credential. [uncertain]
language_level: No explicit CEFR minimum was located in the current programme-specific sources. [uncertain]
personal_preparation_assessment: A non-selective multiple-choice initial-preparation test covers basic mathematics and Earth Sciences. The test does not prevent enrolment. These details come from the 2025/26 didactic regulations and remain to be confirmed for 2026/27. [uncertain]
ofa_or_remedial_obligations: Under the 2025/26 rules, a student who does not take the initial-preparation test or receives an insufficient result must take Mathematics as the first examination. [uncertain]
If the additional educational obligation is not completed within the first year, the student may not take second-year examinations, although enrolment and attendance remain possible. [uncertain]
